name: screen_state_get

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-10-3.1.28 image: on_resume_wrapped (0xc44d7ac) compares this call's result with 2 before resuming a page.

notes: Returns the MiWear screen state; 2 means the panel is on. Used to gate a page push so it never runs against an off screen (that push resets the device on 3.1.28).
